classification: closed integral type-existence subobligation inside W04
verification_kind: Pinned-source and primary-PDF provenance, exact finite dominance and dual-convention checks; the all-rank standard mathematical proof is in the note.
claim: The exact TTypeEx/TypeForAlt integral type exists over the original coefficient DVR, with arbitrary conductor, zero-monodromy discrimination and all weak-correspondence quantifiers.
quantifiers: Every original Hida setting, positive n, original coefficient DVR O, residual datum r, and complex embedding.
Every original type place, whose residue characteristic p differs from ell by St_l; repeated inertial characters and wild ramification are allowed.
Every irreducible admissible local representation; no genericity or temperedness assumption.
Every allowed weak local correspondence; every nonzero representation isotypic for each original group factor.
Every Teichmuller lift in the source contract, handled by uniqueness in the original complete DVR.

decisive_interfaces.zero_monodromy: All-ones partitions are dominance-minimal at fixed basic support, so Shotton 3.7(1),(2) become an exact iff including N=0.
decisive_interfaces.original_coefficients: Choose a finite model E/E0, take a stable O_E lattice by the finite orbit sum, restrict scalars to O, and use normalized LLC equivariance for every conjugate summand.
decisive_interfaces.rank: The local O-rank is [E_u:E0] dim_Eu sigma_u; the simultaneous rank is their product. Empty type set has rank one.
decisive_interfaces.covariance: The source tuple condition is Hom_K(V^dual,pi); choose V=(Res L)^dual.
decisive_interfaces.weak_local_laws: Inertia characters extend to the full local Galois group; Frobenius preserves their isotypic spaces. Semisimplicity makes the parameter toral even with repeats, so the established good-preimage/restricted-uniqueness bridge applies.
decisive_interfaces.isotypic_product: Successive evaluation and Schur's lemma give M=(tensor pi_u) tensor W with W nonzero, retaining all multiplicity spaces.
decisive_interfaces.Teichmuller: Hensel lifts roots of X^(|k|-1)-1 uniquely and multiplicatively; the lift has exactly the residual kernel.

scope_in_source.reducibility_allowed: UnitaryHeckeData:38-41 imposes open-kernel covariance detection, not irreducibility of tau0

limitations: No uniform bound on the coefficient-field enlargement or compact type rank.
No nonzero residual automorphic summand is asserted.
No patched support, full Taylor-Wiles level comparison, two-sided rigidity or moving-family integral Selmer bound is proved.
No whole proof-map node is completed, and no Lean project build is certified.

dominance.scope: Every partition through rank 12 checked against the all-ones minimum; the note proves this in every rank.

covariance.identity: A adj(A) = det(A) I for the universal 3x3 matrix over Z[a0,...,a8]
covariance.scope: Exact polynomial check of the dual convention; the note gives the all-rank matrix argument.

negative_controls: GL2 partition (2) is not dominated by the N=0 partition (1,1); the primary source identifies these with the Steinberg and trivial compact-type cases.
For p=3, ell=7, the order-three character of (1+3Z_3)/(1+9Z_3) is nontrivial on wild inertia and cannot be inflated from F_3^times.
